channel.title: RVA Figure Drawing
channel.description: Figure drawing sessions in Richmond, VA

item.title: Thu, Dec 3 · 7:00 PM – 10:00 PM — Community Care Night: Winter Witch Drink & Draw with RVA Krampusnacht | 18+
item.description: Location: Gallery5, 200 West Marshall Street, Richmond, VA 23220 | Cost: Free (suggested donation $5-10) | RVA Drink & Draw live costumed model drawing hosted by Brit Austin Art. Model Catleesi appears as Frau Perchta, the winter witch. Supplies provided and a bar is on site. Doors at 7 PM.

item.title: Tue, Jan 12 · 6:30 PM – 9:00 PM — Introduction to the Figure with Tommy Van Auken (Week 1 of 8)
item.description: Location: Visual Arts Center of Richmond, 1812 W Main St, Richmond, VA 23220 | Cost: $300 | Instructed 8-week figure drawing class (Intermediate to Advanced), Tuesdays Jan 12 - Mar 2, 2027. Instructor: Tommy Van Auken. $300 is the full-series price.
